fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole pickup truck in the cars by owner section.
findings: Exterior paint looks fairly clean and glossy in the sunlit side shots
Dirt, leaves and debris scattered across the spray-in bedliner floor
Light dust and haze visible on the tailgate and rear bumper in the rear shots
Some road grime on the lower rocker and side step area
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Silverado RST. The paint looks good, but the bed liner has a fair amount of dirt and debris, and the tailgate and rear bumper look a little dusty in the photos. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including a wash and wax and a bed clean-out, so it photographs its best. Would you like a quote?
